title: Phoenix Protocol: Verify IAM Role Visibility Using Read-Only CLI Commands
objectives: Confirm IAM role visibility using standard AWS CLI
Interpret empty or populated output safely
Avoid validation against assumed or hardcoded role names

mission_brief.situation: You are operating in a sandbox or training AWS account where IAM roles may or may not exist.
mission_brief.mission: Verify IAM access by listing roles without creating, modifying, or deleting any IAM resources.
mission_brief.execution: Use read-only AWS CLI commands and validate success based on command execution rather than resource presence.

prerequisites: Valid sandbox or training credentials configured

content.concept: IAM role visibility is a foundational verification step for secure cloud operators. Listing roles confirms permission scope without introducing risk.
content.walkthrough: You will execute a standard AWS CLI command to list IAM roles. The command may return role names or no output at all. Both outcomes are valid.
checkpoints: No assumptions are made about role existence
common_mistakes: Treating empty output as a failure
Attempting to create or modify IAM roles

lab.setup: Use a sandbox or training AWS account. Do not run commands in production environments.
steps: Ensure AWS CLI is installed and configured.
Run the IAM role listing command.
Observe whether output is empty or populated.
Confirm the command completed successfully without errors.

elite_competence.role_simulation: You are validating IAM access in an unknown environment where role presence cannot be assumed.

bug_injection.bug: Validation checks for a hardcoded role name.
bug_injection.fix: Validate execution behavior instead of specific resource identifiers.

pass_conditions: Validation passes in empty or populated environments

interrogation_questions: Why is listing IAM roles safer than creating them?
Why should operators avoid assuming role names?
How does behavior-based validation reduce audit risk?

legal_context.allowed: Executing read-only AWS CLI commands in authorized sandbox or training accounts.
legal_context.prohibited: Creating, modifying, or deleting IAM roles without explicit authorization.

resume_bullets: Verified IAM role visibility using deterministic AWS CLI validation.
Demonstrated safe identity inspection techniques in cloud environments.
Applied audit-safe, read-only IAM verification workflows.
